name: print-social-enjoy-your-music-anywhere-stories-dark-orange-blue-asterisk
title: 'Enjoy Your Music Anywhere' streaming story set on dark charcoal with orange-blue split headlines and asterisk icons
whatItIs: Five dark charcoal vertical story cards with a pill 'YOURLOGO' tag, split-colour headlines ('Enjoy your music anywhere', 'Enjoy your sound and your essence') alternating orange and blue, asterisk icon rows, and pill buttons ('Test 1 month', 'Free', 'Download our app').
whatItMeans: Clean and confident; alternating orange-blue headline colours across cards create rhythm without needing any imagery.
techniques: Alternate two accent colours across headline words per card.
Use a repeated asterisk icon row as a simple brand texture.
Keep every card free of photography for a pure typographic feel.

vocabulary.definition: A headline where different words use different colours.
A layout that relies on text and type rather than imagery.
